item.description:
Beta release — thanks for testing.

New

  • Move through a song. A progress bar under the song shows how far in you are. Drag or click it to jump, or press ← and → to skip 15 seconds. Ambient sounds and radio have no length, so they don't show a bar.
  • Stereo pairs stay ready for Siri. A HomePod bug can leave a stereo pair silent, ignoring Siri and Home scenes, if it's still grouped with another room after the music stops. The app now takes the other rooms out after 30 minutes of quiet, and puts them back when you play on the pair from here. You can turn this off in Settings › General.

Fixes

  • Stereo pairs out of sync. If one speaker of a pair refuses a song, the app sends it through the other one, which also brings the pair back together. While a pair is out of sync, the Speakers box says so.
  • Silent speakers in a group now show "In the group, but not playing" instead of looking like they play.
  • The window keeps the same height whether a song, an ambient sound or nothing is playing, and the Apple Music panel no longer cuts off a warning under Speakers.

Beta release — thanks for testing.

Improvements

  • Space plays and pauses. Press Space in the controls, Apple Music or the mini player, as long as you're not typing.
  • ⌘F searches Apple Music, and opens it first if it's hidden.
  • Settings in tabs. Settings is now split into General, Apple Music, Updates and Advanced, like other Mac apps.

Beta release — thanks for testing.

Improvements

  • Pick the room from Apple Music. Click "Plays on …" at the top of Apple Music to open the room list.
  • Apple Music access in Settings. A new Apple Music section shows whether the app can see your playlists, with a button to allow it or change it.
  • If you said no to Apple Music access, Apple Music shows a small card to turn it on in System Settings. You can hide it.
  • Buttons in Apple Music now light up when you point at them.
  • Reopening Apple Music no longer reloads your playlists and covers every time.

Fixes

  • ⌘, opens Settings again, instead of an empty window.
  • Allowing Apple Music access no longer closes the Apple Music panel.
  • Clicking anywhere else in the app now closes the room list.
